author: ohyeaitskolya
body: I always recommend Lido Bottle Works in Newport. It's a dimly-light, intimate restaurant right on the docks but not over-the-top by any means, mainly because it's so small. Sit at the wine bar or covered patio tables, and you can go for a walk along the docks and hang by the firepits near Nobu afterwards. Wine and apps you can walk out without breaking the bank, their dinner is a little steeper, though.
